text: The earlier landing grep used --include, which BusyBox rejects, so its empty output means nothing. Fix the radar list first and redo the landing search.
command: cd /work/apps/canvas/src && sed -i '157s/overflow-y: visible/overflow-y: auto/' ops/radar.css && sed -n '157p' ops/radar.css | cut -c1-200 && find ops insights desk -type f -name '*.*ss' -o -type f -name '*.tsx' | xargs grep -niE 'landing' | cut -c1-250 | head -20
